QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_16

question.text: The portion of fund return that accrues to investors only, based on the hurdle rate, is known as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Return generated using the hurdle rate is called 'Preferred Return' — allocated pro-rata to investors; not available for incentive fees. The Trap: Catch-up is a subsequent waterfall tier; NAV is valuation; Alpha is excess return over benchmark. Cross-Exam Context: Same preferred-return concept in XIX-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Teach investors this term so they can identify it in the distribution waterfall section of the PPM.
